posts.name: Eva Nambison
posts.cooked:
Good Evening Sir/Ma’am,

I wanted to practice BPT and oppe-practice questions before NPPE practice question but permission is denied to view and check those questions again. Can you please tell me what should I do in this Case?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
I think you did ssh-keygen and created a new public-private key pair that’s why you are getting permission denied so submit the new public key to the se2001 vm website by just doing
cd .ssh folder
cat your public key file and paste it to the vm then you’ll get back the access

posts.name: Eva Nambison
posts.cooked: Ok…I’ll try that. Thank you
